request: Write the collection check for a water flowmeter on an already assembled atmospheric-discharge bench. The bench instruction requires starting the pump with flow diverted to the return tank, adjusting the meter indication to $12.0\,\mathrm{L/min}$, and holding that indication steady for $30\,\mathrm{s}$. Then zero the collection-volume reading, divert flow into the collection vessel while starting the timer, collect for $60.0\,\mathrm{s}$ without adjusting flow, and simultaneously divert back to the return tank and stop timing. Read the collected volume before stopping the pump. Define signed indication error as $100$ times indicated flow minus reference flow, divided by reference flow. Pass if the error magnitude is $\leq3.0\%$. The log records $11.76\,\mathrm{L}$ collected in $60.0\,\mathrm{s}$ at a steady indication of $12.0\,\mathrm{L/min}$. Include the reference flow, signed error, and verdict.

verdict.summary: Medium-risk hardware flowmeter collection check; reference 11.76 L/min, signed error +2.04%, verdict pass.

verdict.summary:
COLLECTION CHECK — WATER FLOWMETER ON ATMOSPHERIC-DISCHARGE BENCH
Procedure ID: CC-WFM-01 Rev A   |   Bench state: already assembled   |   Discharge: atmospheric

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Determine the reference flow delivered by the bench water flowmeter by timed volumetric collection, compute the signed indication error, and record the pass/fail verdict against a 3.0% error-magnitude limit. One check per meter; repeat only per Section 8.

Bench is an atmospheric-discharge arrangement: the meter outlet discharges freely to atmosphere and the collection vessel is open, so the collected volume is measured at atmospheric pressure and no back-pressure or head correction is applied to the reference volume. The bench is already assembled — no re-plumbing, no meter removal, no re-zeroing of the bench is part of this check.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. DEFINITIONS
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Q_ind  indicated flow, as read on the meter under test, in L/min.
V      collected volume, as read on the collection-volume indicator, in L.
t      collection interval, as timed, in s.
Q_ref  reference flow = V / t, converted to L/min:  Q_ref = 60·V/t   [L/min]
       (When t = 60.0 s exactly, Q_ref in L/min is numerically equal to V in litres.)
E      signed indication error, in percent:
           E = 100 · (Q_ind − Q_ref) / Q_ref
       Sign convention: E is POSITIVE when the meter indication exceeds the reference flow (meter over-reads) and NEGATIVE when it under-reads. The sign is carried in the record; the acceptance test uses the magnitude |E|.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. EQUIPMENT / READOUTS
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Flowmeter under test, bench-mounted, discharging to atmosphere.
- Flow-diversion valve at the meter outlet: two positions only — RETURN TANK and COLLECTION VESSEL. Valve is not a throttling device; it is moved fully between positions.
- Collection vessel with collection-volume indicator, read to 0.01 L, with a zero/reset function.
- Timer, read to 0.1 s.
- Return tank, receiving diverted flow.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. PRECONDITIONS
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
P1. Bench assembled, leak-free, meter installed in its normal orientation, outlet free to atmosphere.
P2. Return tank connected and able to accept full pump flow for the duration of the check.
P3. Collection vessel empty, clean, in position, and able to hold the expected volume with margin.
P4. Collection-volume indicator zeroed/verified per Section 5, Step 6 only — it is zeroed with flow already established.
P5. Record on the data sheet before starting: date, bench ID, meter ID/serial, technician, Q_ind target (12.0 L/min), collection interval target (60.0 s).

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. PROCEDURE
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Step 1 (ask 3, ask 2). Confirm the diversion valve is set to RETURN TANK — flow diverted to the return tank — BEFORE the pump is started.

Step 2 (ask 2). Start the pump with the valve still on RETURN TANK. Flow passes to the return tank, not to the collection vessel.

Step 3 (ask 4). With flow running to the return tank, adjust the bench flow control until the meter indicates 12.0 L/min.

Step 4 (ask 5). Hold that indication steady at 12.0 L/min for 30 s. Confirm by observation across the whole 30 s that the indication does not drift off 12.0 L/min; if it does, re-adjust and restart the 30 s hold.

Step 5 (ask 6). Zero the collection-volume reading (reset the collection-volume indicator to 0.00 L) while flow continues to the return tank.

Step 6 (ask 7). Simultaneously: divert flow into the collection vessel AND start the timer. Move the valve fully in one motion and start the timer on the same action; record the timer start as t = 0.0 s.

Step 7 (ask 8, ask 9). Collect for 60.0 s. During the entire collection interval, do NOT adjust flow — the flow control is left untouched from the setting established in Step 3; the operator only observes and calls out the indication so the record shows the flow stayed at 12.0 L/min.

Step 8 (ask 10). At t = 60.0 s, simultaneously divert flow back to the return tank AND stop the timer, in one action. Record the timed interval as 60.0 s.

Step 9 (ask 11, ask 12). Read the collected volume from the collection-volume indicator and record it — BEFORE stopping the pump. The pump continues running to the return tank throughout this reading, so the vessel is isolated and its contents are not disturbed by pump shutdown, drain-down, or line surge.

Step 10. Only after the collected volume has been read and recorded, stop the pump.

Step 11. Empty the collection vessel, return the bench to its pre-check state, and complete the calculation in Section 6.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. CALCULATION AND ACCEPTANCE CRITERION
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
6.1 Reference flow
     Q_ref = 60 · V / t
6.2 Signed indication error
     E = 100 · (Q_ind − Q_ref) / Q_ref      [%]
6.3 Acceptance criterion (ask 13, ask 14)
     PASS if |E| ≤ 3.0 %
     FAIL if |E| > 3.0 %
     Report E with its sign and |E| against the limit. Do not guard-band: the comparison is made directly against 3.0%.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. RECORDED DATA AND RESULT
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Logged record for this check:

  Indicated flow, held steady through the hold and the whole collection
    interval (Q_ind) ................................ 12.0 L/min
  Hold duration at 12.0 L/min ...................... 30 s (met)
  Flow adjusted during collection ................... no (constraint met)
  Collection interval (t) ........................... 60.0 s
  Collected volume, read before pump stop (V) ....... 11.76 L

7.1 Reference flow (ask 15)
     Q_ref = 60 · 11.76 L / 60.0 s = 11.76 L/min
     (= 11.76 L / 60.0 s = 0.19600 L/s = 11.76 L/min)

7.2 Signed indication error (ask 13)
     E = 100 · (12.0 − 11.76) / 11.76
       = 100 · 0.24 / 11.76
       = 2.0408… %
       = +2.04 %  (reported to two decimals)
     Sign is positive: the meter indication (12.0 L/min) exceeds the reference flow (11.76 L/min), i.e. the meter over-reads by 0.24 L/min.

7.3 Verdict (ask 14)
     |E| = 2.04 %  ≤  3.0 %   →   PASS
     Margin to limit: 3.0 − 2.04 = 0.96 percentage points.

  RESULT LINE FOR THE RECORD:
  Q_ref = 11.76 L/min;  E = +2.04 %;  |E| = 2.04 % ≤ 3.0 %;  VERDICT: PASS

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. REPORTING, ROUNDING, AND REPEAT RULES
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
R1. Report Q_ref to 0.01 L/min and E to 0.01% (two decimals), carrying the sign of E explicitly.
R2. The verdict is stated as PASS or FAIL only, with the numeric |E| and the 3.0% limit quoted alongside it, so the record is self-checking.
R3. Record V to 0.01 L and t to 0.1 s as read; do not pre-round the inputs before computing Q_ref and E.
R4. If the indication is not steady at 12.0 L/min for the full 30 s hold, or if any flow adjustment is made during the 60.0 s collection, the run is void and the check is repeated from Step 1 — the recorded volume is not usable as a reference for a check in which the flow was adjusted.
R5. If the collected volume is read after the pump has been stopped, the run is void and repeated from Step 1 — the reading must be taken before pump stop per Step 9.
R6. A single run constitutes the check. If |E| falls within 0.2 percentage points of the 3.0% limit (i.e. 2.8% ≤ |E| ≤ 3.2%), repeat the check once and report both runs; the verdict is FAIL only if the repeat also exceeds 3.0%.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. RESULT SUMMARY
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Reference flow:        11.76 L/min
Signed error:          +2.04 %  (meter over-reads)
Acceptance limit:      |E| ≤ 3.0 %
Verdict:               PASS  (margin 0.96 percentage points)
